meta.schema_note: Maps the 19 substantive categories of the ONS detailed tick-box ethnic group classification (ethnic_group_tb_20b) to the 5 YJB high-level groups. This is the ONS standard rollup, identical to the ONS high-level categorisation ethnic_group_tb_6a; PRISM-R adopts it rather than defining its own. Provenance documentation; the pipeline ingests the 5-category Census pull directly.
